info.title: ConstructHub API
info.description:
ConstructHub Construction Management Platform API.

**How to use:** Click "Try it out" on any endpoint, fill in the `x-role` header field with one of: `superuser`, `project_manager`, `site_engineer`, `finance_manager`, `client`, then click Execute.

**Middleware active:**
- 🔒 Security headers + Rate Limiting (120 req/min per IP)
- 📝 Request logging to `logs/access-YYYY-MM-DD.log`
- ❌ Error logging to `logs/error-YYYY-MM-DD.log`
- 🆔 Request ID tracing (`x-request-id` header)
- 📁 File uploads via `POST /reports/upload`
- 🛡️ Auth middleware on all protected routes
